title: Add Availability time split dropdowns + header theme toggle button

requirements.summary: Replace Add Availability start-time single select with Hour/Minute/AM-PM dropdowns while preserving the stored time string format and edit prefill behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: The start time control in `frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.tsx` no longer uses the single Select bound directly to `time`.
The UI shows three dropdowns labeled Hour, Minute, and AM/PM for selecting a start time.
Selecting values in the three dropdowns updates the availability `time` value used on submit to match the existing string style (e.g., "10:00 AM").
When editing an existing availability, the existing `time` value pre-populates the three dropdowns correctly for all values previously offered in the time list (8:00 AM through 9:00 PM).
If the existing saved `time` value is not parseable into Hour/Minute/AM-PM, the UI still displays a safe fallback state and does not crash; the user can select a new time and save successfully.
User-facing text remains in English (e.g., labels and placeholders).

file_operations.description: Replace the current single Select bound to `time` with three composed Select controls (Hour, Minute, AM/PM) using existing shadcn Select components (do not edit `frontend/src/components/ui/*`). Add parsing of an existing `availability.time` string to pre-populate hour/minute/period on edit, add safe fallback state when parsing fails, and derive the submitted `time` string from the three dropdown selections in the same format as before (e.g., "8:00 AM"). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add small utilities for (a) formatting hour+minute+period into the existing stored time string (no leading zero hour, e.g., "8:00 AM"), (b) parsing an existing stored time string into {hour, minute, period} with validation and a safe failure result, and (c) providing the allowed Hour/Minute/AM-PM option lists matching the previously supported range (8:00 AM through 9:00 PM, minutes limited to supported values).

requirements.summary: Move the theme toggle out of the profile dropdown into a dedicated header button immediately left of the profile menu trigger.
acceptanceCriteria: In `frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.tsx`, the theme toggle is no longer rendered as a `DropdownMenuItem` inside the profile dropdown.
A standalone button (icon or text) appears in the header to the left of the profile dropdown trigger when the user is logged in.
Clicking the new header theme button calls the existing theme toggle behavior (switching between light and dark) and continues to persist via `localStorage` as before.
The profile dropdown still includes Logout and continues to function as before.

file_operations.description: Refactor the logged-in header area to render a standalone theme toggle Button immediately to the left of the profile DropdownMenuTrigger, wired to the existing `useTheme().toggleTheme` behavior. Remove the theme toggle DropdownMenuItem from the dropdown content, leaving Logout intact. Use existing shadcn Button/DropdownMenu components (do not edit `frontend/src/components/ui/*`). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
